𝗥𝗘𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗖𝗛 𝗗𝗔𝗬! 🇮🇳🇵🇰

Pakistan U19 won the group game by 3 wkts (Zahoor 100*; Rajput 107 for India).
The final starts 10:30 AM IST today.

Can India turn it around? 👇

#U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK
